narrative: The technology landscape is increasingly shaped by advancements in AI, with new models facing scrutiny over inherent security flaws and regulatory frameworks emerging to govern large platforms. Significant progress in autonomous vehicles is clearing pathways for commercial robotaxi services, while core infrastructure providers are enhancing developer platforms and security measures. The semiconductor industry also sees shifts with impending price hikes and continued focus on AI-driven efficiency in chip design.

highlights.title: A fundamental flaw leaves LLMs strikingly vulnerable to attack
highlights.whyItMatters: Researchers identified an inherent flaw making large language models fundamentally insecure against certain attacks, raising significant safety concerns for AI technology.

highlights.title: Zoox clears final federal hurdle to launch paid robotaxi service
highlights.whyItMatters: Amazon-owned Zoox has received a crucial federal exemption, paving the way for the commercial launch of its custom-built robotaxi service.

highlights.title: Launch HN: Prized (YC S26) – Let non-engineer staff build secure internal tools
highlights.whyItMatters: Prized enables non-engineers to securely build full-stack internal applications connected to company data without managing API keys or complex integrations.

highlights.title: Starburst Galaxy Centaurus A
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has captured stunning new details of the active Centaurus A galaxy, revealing complex dusty structures and hidden starburst activity.

highlights.title: Dogfooding at scale: migrating cdnjs to Cloudflare’s Developer Platform
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare successfully migrated its massive cdnjs service to its own developer platform, demonstrating the robustness and scalability of its Workers and Workflow tools.

highlights.title: ChatGPT, Roblox to Fall Under Strictest EU Rules for Platforms
highlights.whyItMatters: The EU is expanding its strictest digital regulations to include platforms like ChatGPT and Roblox, indicating a growing global trend toward governing large digital and AI services.

highlights.title: Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st
highlights.whyItMatters: Qualcomm's upcoming price increases on all its processors will contribute to higher costs for consumers in the mobile device market.

highlights.title: CosmosEscape: Taking over Every Database in Azure Cosmos DB
highlights.whyItMatters: A critical new vulnerability allows attackers to gain full control over Azure Cosmos DB databases, exposing a significant security risk for cloud users.

topics.name: AI Advancements & Safety
topics.summary: The AI sector sees rapid development in models and agentic capabilities, alongside critical discussions on security vulnerabilities, ethical guidelines, and regulatory oversight.

topics.name: Autonomous Systems
topics.summary: Progress in self-driving technology is leading to commercial robotaxi launches, with continued regulatory and safety evaluations shaping deployment.

topics.name: Cloud & Infrastructure
topics.summary: Major cloud providers and infrastructure companies are enhancing developer platforms, security, and scalability, with new services and migrations demonstrating robust capabilities.

topics.name: Space & Science
topics.summary: New discoveries from space telescopes continue to reveal insights into the universe, while NASA advances exploration missions and innovative technology concepts.

topics.name: Technology Policy & Market
topics.summary: Regulatory bodies are increasing scrutiny on large tech platforms and AI, while market shifts like semiconductor price adjustments impact the broader technology landscape.
